definitions.explanation: The state of combustion producing heat and light.

⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{火|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦{暖|あたた}まった→暖まる：01856_atatamaru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I started a fire and warmed up.

examples.english: When I lit a candle in the dark room, the small flame flickered quietly and it was very beautiful.

notes:
{火|ひ} is a fundamental noun for fire, flames, and heat sources.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {火|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to light, ignite
- {火|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to put out a fire
- {火|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to start a fire
- {火|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to be careful with fire
- {火|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用心|ようじん}→用心：03659_youjin⟧: fire prevention
{火|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧ - to add fuel to the fire (make things worse)
